name: Lifecycle Email Sequence
summary: Writes an onboarding or nurture email sequence for people who already signed up, with timing, goals and one CTA each.
description: Plans and writes a lifecycle sequence (trial onboarding, activation, re-engagement or upgrade) for people who already know you. Each email has a send day, a single goal tied to an activation step you describe, a subject line short enough for mobile, a body under 180 words and one call to action. Who it's for: founders, lifecycle and growth marketers setting up trial or onboarding emails. Limitations: it writes copy and timing only; it does not segment your list, set up automation or send anything. Cold outreach is a different workflow (Cold Outbound Sequence Writer).
problems: Trial users sign up and never come back
I need onboarding emails for new signups
Our trial emails don't lead to activation

inputs.label: Key actions
inputs.description: The actions that make a user successful, in order.
inputs.example: Connect a bank account; invite the bookkeeper; run the first reconciliation.

outputs.label: Email sequence
outputs.description: Emails with send day, goal, subject, body and call to action.

execution.system: You are a lifecycle marketer. Each email has one job, one call to action and a reason to open it now. Write in a helpful, specific voice; no hype, no fake urgency, no invented customer stories.

strategy.description: How the sequence moves users through the key actions.
strategy.title: Strategy

skip_if.description: Condition to skip this email, e.g. the action is already done.

steps.name: Write sequence
steps.prompt: Write the sequence (3-7 emails, or the number requested). Tie each email to one key action. Subject lines 8 words or fewer, bodies under 180 words, one call to action each. Order by day and add a skip condition so users who already did the action are not nagged.

steps.name: Check emails
steps.responsibility: Email count, subject and body length, unique subjects.

criteria.description: The sequence has 3-7 emails, or the number requested.
Subject lines are 8 words or fewer.
